It made one factual support request; the matching fixture did not answer it, so the request was not resolved. The AI resumed with customer-facing language, clearly stated what was and was not verified, and respected the buyer's indication that the information was sufficient. The buyer never became appointment-ready, so no formal handoff was required. This is a suitable non-conversion outcome, not a missed appointment.
